request.summary: Distill a reusable conversational delivery unit for the ontology narration.
request.intent: Make the script sound like a guided conversation while preserving its conceptual and authority distinctions.

outputs: conversational turn as the smallest coherent delivery unit
two-round inline Proposer and Balancer reconciliation
1521-word narration within the requested pace band
validation: Standard mode used one proposal track and two recursive rounds
conversational guidance versus cue-density risk was reconciled
conversational compression versus semantic-boundary risk was reconciled
the delivery unit recomposes through definition, contexts, approval, relationships, memory, Augmentor, and the closing owner boundary
all section paces remain between 120.0 and 126.7 WPM
execution.notes: The optimization point is one conversational turn containing an entry cue, one idea, and either a consequence or next question. Inline role simulation was used because no governed multi-agent dispatch was authorized.
